text: Binary row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): returns 1 if at least one comment contains a concrete real-world example offered in the commenter's own argument, i.e. a specific actual case, event, person, institution, statistic tied to a real case, or concrete personal experience; otherwise 0. Invented/hypothetical scenarios and purely abstract principles don't count; no outside verification needed; example lists are nonexhaustive. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not an example or announcement; moderator/bot notices don't count; list order is irrelevant. A valid empty list or no qualifying comment gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null.
